blocks.html: Darren Espanto, the country’s total performer and Nik Qistina, Malaysia’s teen star, teamed up with renowned director, Dir. Paul Alexei Basinillo, to shoot their newest single titled “Young Hearts” at Robinsons Galleria. Dir. Paul Alexei Basinillo is an award-winning director famous for his TV Commercials which gained recognition at the New York Fest and the Ad fest. He is also known for shooting Sarah Geronimo’s 24/SG concert in 2012 and for her Kilometro Music Video. The stripped down version of the song “Young Hearts” is Darren and Nik’s first collaboration together which focuses on the teenage struggle of looking for love in all the wrong places, getting to know yourself, and understanding that there are better and bigger things out there. The two talented singers also had a meet & greet session with the community of RLC who were all very happy to see the duo together. “Young Hearts” will be released within this month and fans of both singers can expect another breathtaking song to listen to.
